reply_text: Sofia, the February thread in #coastal-team settles it: **Pellow**. On 17 Feb, Kwame wrote that your retail account is the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup, and you confirmed it. That account is Pellow Home Living, renamed from Covey & Lark Retail. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal rows, so the two were getting mixed up under the "PHL" filter.
